units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:24">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>כגון הדה בית מעון שיורדים לה מפ׳ וכ׳</he> like Beth-Maʿon to which they go down when coming from P., and up from Tiberias; (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85:6">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> <he>כפר שובתי</he>; Y. Sot. I, 17ᵃ bot. <cite ref="Q01033"><he>פלטתה</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Amos 6:6">Am. VI, 6</cite>) they got their wine <he>מפ̇ל̇וג̇ת̇א שעל יינם נתפ̇ת̇ו וג̇ל̇ו וכ׳</he> from P., for on account of their wine the ten tribes were led astray, and had to go into exile (v. <cite ref="Q02128"><he>פְּתוּגְתָּא</he></cite>); <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 10">Num. R. s. 10</cite>; Yalk. Am. 545.
